sources_considered.why: The strongest retrieved company account of Claude enabling smaller teams to perform formerly larger-team operations.
Documents substantial customer-support automation while explicitly saying the workforce was retained.
Read in full. It describes automated support and reassigned workers, but supplies no independently verified replacement case beyond the issues already represented by the selected sources.
Read relevant passages. The benchmark tests workplace tasks rather than sustained replacement of actual workers, and its original models predate the post.

evidence_items.locator: Transforming results for businesses, final paragraph
evidence_items.explanation: The case study identifies Claude as the platform's central orchestrator and reports that clients need smaller teams for the same operations. This challenges the categorical claim, but does not identify replaced roles, staffing counts, duration, or independent performance verification.

evidence_items.locator: Transforming support operations and boosting revenue, quotation from Marcin Gwizdała
evidence_items.explanation: Tidio reports substantial Claude-powered support automation alongside retaining and reassigning its agents. This demonstrates why automation percentages alone cannot establish worker replacement, while retained staffing cannot establish inability to replace workers.

unresolved_gaps: No retrieved record independently verifies the roles, staffing changes, duration, and work quality underlying Advolve's account.
The case studies do not establish the limits of all Anthropic software available at publication.
The accessible case-study pages are live pages; their initial publication dates do not independently establish that every current sentence appeared in the original versions.
